Independent READ-ONLY review — Russian batch085

Snapshot
RU_ROOT branch: full-ru-085-separation-effort-truth-answers-parents-and-topics-kanji.
Candidate f51729787560f381aef43938516767a089073a84: unchanged, tracked-clean; manifest 6101e469724d76b4.
Accepted-main baseline 04ab33565b7a19f59aa954eaa2294b08c850f109: 2018 accepted objects remain.
FROZEN_EN_ROOT source: 6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f.
Candidate: 2030 runtime objects = 1478 words + 261 kanji + 261 strokes; NOT made accepted by this report.
PRIVATE_ARTIFACT_ROOT CURRENT RAW SHA256 identities:
Pool 00bb42f27d8d2c9c4fce39c8c0ae57d8f4d6b3f3932a41bb9badfb80740401ac
Binding 8c245a71db546814213ef0530693bd11f5b1894f65e4e527b2821b3db5102765
Scope 2edf30dbfcfcf2f905728a4045dddec521a9c79fd5c017a077e181639d8bc742
CURRENT pool, not prospective; working-RAW is not Git/LF.

Actual reading
Completed four current RU guidance files and three localized rubrics. Read six primary and 39 contextual complete EN/RU pairs: 90 whole teaching bodies, 45 EN/45 RU. Contextual scope: 24 kanji and 15 words. All 15 changed word lessons were read whole in CURRENT form; historical baseline bodies were not newly assigned.
Read 232 whole official TEXT units: 35 KANJIDIC records + six classical Unicode radical rows + 182 ordered entity-expanded JMdict objects + six KanjiPedia kanji TEXT projections + three supplemental lexical TEXT entries. Separately read one complete provider header: file_version 4, database_version 2026-308, creation 2026-11-04. Zero pixel views; no whole-HTML/source-file or historical-glyph inspection claim.
Read all 261 CURRENT typed pool rows/offered titles, 18 original directed proposals, six lesson rulings, 15 exact NAV-only diffs/15 wrappers, six outside-edge observations and five dictionary clarifications. Typed rows are not 261 whole lessons or 1478 fresh word reviews. All bounded reads returned complete payloads/markers and exit0; captures/hashes were not reading credit.

Independent verdicts
C1 — PASS within assigned source-content scope. Selected inventories/arrays, readings, okurigana/bound forms, strokes, classical keys, examples and grammar are supported. N4 is explicitly a community classification, not a purported matching legacy KANJIDIC-JLPT value. No metadata correction warranted. Visual stories are modern mnemonics, not verified etymology.
C2 — QUALIFIED SOURCE PASS. Assigned links/dependencies, stroke bindings and source annotations are coherent. All 15 word diffs only add link wrappers, preserving semantic text, examples and arrays. Each direction below supports only its exact introductory-core contrast, NOT ordinary quiz/fallback activation.
C3 — PASS for the entire assigned learner-facing scope: useful Russian without English dependency or title-only placeholders; complete reading/example mapping. No consequential mistranslation, grammatical teaching error or unsupported beginner superlative established.
Substantive source fixes: none established; no file:line finding to report. Optional polish: none required. Confidence: high only within these boundaries.

Original directed-edge dispositions
Q = supported introductory-core contrast ONLY. Every original row below is independently Q for sign→actual offered Russian title. U = broader suitability unverified. Prefix for every ID is 085-.
N001 別→男 «мужчина; мужской пол»: separation/otherness is not a man; parting involving a man is only a situation.
N002 別→勉 «стараться; прилагать усилия»: division/parting is not striving; effort spent separating is not equivalence.
N003 別→帰 «возвращаться домой»: parting is not returning home; successive events do not merge meanings.
N004 勉→力 «сила; мощь»: striving is not offered strength/power. 力's effort sense and rare 力める/勉める spellings establish relatedness, not that 勉 means this offered title. They prevent universal/reciprocal clearance.
N005 勉→動 «двигаться; движение»: effort need not denote movement, although it can involve movement.
N006 勉→色 «цвет»: effort is not colour; wider 色 uses and shape resemblance do not supply equivalence.
N007 真→目 «глаз»: truth/genuineness is not an eye; component membership does not transfer standalone meaning.
N008 真→百 «сто»: truth and the ま- intensifier do not denote one hundred.
N009 真→員 «член группы; сотрудник»: genuineness does not denote membership/staff; a genuine employee is only an associated context.
N010 答→会 «встречаться; встреча»: answering is not meeting. Mnemonic 合 is not offered 会; wider correspondence/gathering uses do not erase this bounded distinction.
N011 答→茶 «чай»: response/solution is not tea; visual similarity is not semantic evidence.
N012 答→書 «писать»: answer content is not the writing action; 答えを書く combines them without equating them.
N013 親→新 «новый»: parent/familiarity is not newness; shared シン and similar shapes do not establish equivalence.
N014 親→見 «видеть; смотреть»: parent/closeness is not seeing; 見147 is an index/component, not a transferable definition.
N015 親→題 «тема; вопрос»: kinship/familiarity is not a topic/question; a family topic is only a situation.
N016 題→質 «качество; сущность»: topic/title/test question is not offered quality/essence. 質す questioning and 題's evaluating sense do not prove this forward equivalence: evaluating quality is not naming quality itself. Reverse/all-sense safety stays U.
N017 題→親 «родитель; близкий»: topic/question does not denote parent/interpersonal closeness; assessed separately, not inherited from N015.
N018 題→週 «неделя»: topic/question/title is not a calendar week; weekly scheduling does not change this.
Result: 18 Q introductory contrasts; zero directions altered/removed. All 18 ordinary-runtime/fallback suitability judgments remain U. No reverse, transitive, clique, universal-all-sense, frequency or necessity approval follows.

Six lesson rulings — independent dispositions
085-L001, RU_ROOT\kanji\別.md — ACCEPT bounded ruling: retain ベツ/わか.れる/わ.ける, 7 strokes, 刀18. Whole1503000 supports rare-spelling 別ける; personal parting versus division is not universal separation.
085-L002, RU_ROOT\kanji\勉.md — ACCEPT bounded ruling: retain ベン/つと.める, 10 strokes, 力19. Whole1240820 supports 勉める/努める; separately read 勤める/務める are not erased. Beginner superlative removed; N004 has only the Q disposition above.
085-L003, RU_ROOT\kanji\真.md — ACCEPT bounded ruling: retain シン/ま/ま-/まこと, 10 strokes, 目109. Bare noun ま differs from prefix ま-; 真に受ける is まにうける. Supplemental 真まこと gives ―の道, supporting retained まことの; separate しんの entry is not contrary evidence. No blanket register/frequency conclusion.
085-L004, RU_ROOT\kanji\答.md — ACCEPT bounded ruling: retain トウ/こた.える/こた.え, 12 strokes, 竹118. 質問に答える and 答えを書く distinguish に/を roles. 回答/解答 is not an absolute all-context split; bamboo/合/口 story is explicitly invented mnemonic.
085-L005, RU_ROOT\kanji\親.md — ACCEPT bounded ruling: retain シン/おや/おや-/した.しい/した.しむ, 16 strokes, 見147. 親子 covers bound おや-; 親しむ is godan, not adjective 親しい. Whole1365040 restricts parent sense to 親, not alternative 祖. Familiarity need not be kinship/helpfulness.
085-L006, RU_ROOT\kanji\題.md — ACCEPT bounded ruling: retain selected ダイ/empty kun, 18 strokes, 頁181. Extra KanjiPedia 音テイ is distinguished from selected KANJIDIC inventory; historical forehead meaning creates no kun ひたい. Topic is not universal trouble; N016 remains bounded Q.

Five separate dictionary clarifications
085-A001 — ACCEPT: attested 別ける has the spelling-specific rare flag; this neither deletes わ.ける nor makes 分/別 universally disjoint.
085-A002 — ACCEPT: rare written 勉める is supported; spelling rarity is not whole-word frequency/modern necessity. Unsupported usefulness superlative is absent.
085-A003 — ACCEPT: preserve bare/bound ま and まこと/まことに/まことの, separately explaining しんに/しんの. Supplemental lexical entries support the disputed readings; no false wrong-reading rejection.
085-A004 — ACCEPT: 親子 and frozen 本に親しむ are supportable. Supplemental 親しむ sense② supports ongoing familiarity with things; its actual example is 土に親しむ, NOT a direct quotation of 本に親しむ.
085-A005 — ACCEPT: preserve exact empty selected kun inventory; acknowledge KanjiPedia-only テイ without silent metadata amendment or invented forehead reading.

Pool observations and limitations
All six outside-edge observations are retained as limitations, not new guards: 別 with 分/切/去 (actual division overlap); 勉 with 力/強/学/習/研/究 (effort/strength/study); 真 with 正/本/白 (truth/correctness/originality/intensification); 答 with 書/言/話/会 (response/writing/speech/correspondence); 親 with 近/父/母/友/族/子 (closeness/family); 題 with 問/質/名/事/意/文 (question/title/subject/evaluation).
Actual pool titles 正 «правильный; верный», 近 «близкий», 問 «спрашивать; вопрос» and 分 «минута; часть» do not establish universal separation from 真, 親, 題 and 別. These are bounded observations, not exhaustive global certification or fresh full-body reviews of every listed provider. No new guards established.
Broader ordinary quiz/fallback suitability, modern necessity-frequency and exhaustive global/future uniqueness remain U. Existing 1478-wordguard judgments retain only their previous scope/identity. Prior 082-N007 姉→妹 remains actual U, not upgraded by typed metadata reading.
Protected RU_ROOT\docs\translation-drafts\033-nature-outdoor-activity\words\空.md remains excluded U/runtime-absent/not media; accepted077 kanji 空 does not resolve its distant-place-caption issue. No expansion to the 8278-object corpus.

Final verification
Post-reading gate and full h.verify() completed exit0 on the unchanged snapshot, matching candidate, baseline, source and all three CURRENT RAW hashes above. Verification is not content-reading credit. No writes, delegation, tests/builds, Git mutation, network/auth or media/device operations performed; existing tools\__pycache__ preserved. No native/device/phone/IME/media/release/ordinary-RU-default approval; C6/C7 do not block this separately bounded source review.
